reason: The plugin is primarily an integration bridge between DeepSeek Harness and Paper Desktop via MCP, exposing Paper design MCP operations as native DSH tools plus design skills and guide/context injection, with additional reconnect and OAuth command support for servers that require authentication. Core capabilities include tool invocation, screenshot/image attachment handling, and auth token workflow, so it is best classified as an external-services integration plugin with medium risk due network/auth/token state and external tool control.

summaries.zh: 该插件是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于将 Paper Desktop 的 MCP 工具桥接为本地 paper_* 工具与设计技能，并提供重连与 OAuth 认证命令入口。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness bundle that bridges Paper Desktop MCP functionality into native paper_* tools and design skills, with reconnect and OAuth auth command support.

capabilities: MCP tool/session bridging with a local/remote server endpoint
Exposure of Paper design operations through native DSH tools and skills
Screenshot capture output handling via attachment-backed image blocks
Prompt/guide injection behavior within agent context

reasons.code: README states the plugin connects to Paper Desktop MCP and registers Paper tools as native paper_* tools on the DSH context.
README states get_screenshot image blocks are decoded and saved through ctx.attachments as image-backed outputs.
README documents discovery-driven OAuth, token exchange/refresh, bearer-token persistence at $DSH_HOME/paper-design/oauth.json, and auth management commands.
Repository tree and source layout include mcp-client.ts, auth.ts, and schema/guide/skills modules for runtime connectivity and command/assistant integrations.
Package manifest declares this as a DeepSeek Harness bundle with tool/system-prompt/attachment/skill/command peer dependencies.

capabilities: MCP tool/session bridging with a local/remote server endpoint
Exposure of Paper design operations through native DSH tools and skills
